design_concept.core_philosophy: A digital sanctuary. Uses high-contrast editorial typography, earthy color palettes, intentional negative space, and slow, fluid animations to lower visitor heart rates and build trust.

rules: Use Cormorant Garamond in italic for selected emphasis words within headings to create an editorial feel.
Never use default bold for headings; rely on weight contrast (e.g., Light 300 vs Medium 500) and immense size.
Overlines must always be Manrope, uppercase, and widely spaced.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use extreme padding: py-24, py-32, py-40 for section breaks to create a 'breathing' rhythm.
layout_and_spacing.grid: Bento-style and asymmetrical. Avoid standard 50/50 splits. Use 4-column or 12-column grids where elements span unevenly (e.g., col-span-5 and col-span-7).
layout_and_spacing.corners: Mix rounded-none for rigid luxury with rounded-full for organic call-to-actions.
layout_and_spacing.image_treatment: Clip images into distinct aspect ratios (e.g., tall 3:4 or cinematic 16:9). Do not fill standard squares.

motion.global: Implement 'lenis' for buttery smooth momentum scrolling. All interactions must feel deliberate and unhurried.
motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion. Wrap each line of text in an overflow-hidden div, and translate the text up from y: '100%' with a duration of 1.2s and ease: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1].
motion.scroll_reveal: Fade in and slight upward translation (y: 40 to 0) tied to scroll viewport entry.
motion.parallax: Use useScroll and useTransform for images so they move slightly slower than the page scroll, creating depth.

hero_ambient.description: Serene luxury spa bathtub environment for atmospheric background.
hero_ambient.usage: Hero section background with dark overlay, or high-end parallax asset.

facials.description: Artistic portrait of woman with closed eyes through glass.

hair_salon.description: Modern hair salon chairs and round mirrors.

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Thin or Light weight) for an elegant, minimal look.

sections_blueprint.name: Navigation
sections_blueprint.features: Crystal Glassmorphism header. Absolute positioned at top. Contains elegant brand text 'VITAL BODY', simple navigation links, and a pill-shaped CTA.

sections_blueprint.name: Hero Section
sections_blueprint.features: Massive screen-filling section. Background is a slow-panning, dimly lit luxury spa image (or color overlay). Features the masked line-by-line reveal of 'A Place of Transformation'. Includes an aesthetic scroll indicator at the bottom.

sections_blueprint.name: Editorial Marquee
sections_blueprint.features: react-fast-marquee component. Very slow organic drift. Text: '* Wellness & Beauty * Body * Heart * Soul * Ventura, CA *'. Uses Cormorant Garamond, italicized, low contrast (e.g., text-brand-muted on secondary bg).

sections_blueprint.name: Manifesto (Brand Copy)
sections_blueprint.features: Numbered layout (01. The Body, 02. The Heart, 03. The Soul). Features the core copy: 'We offer a unique space where you will feel nurtured and revitalized...'. Asymmetrical typography with huge numbers and indented paragraphs.

sections_blueprint.name: Services Showcase
sections_blueprint.features: Interactive accordion or hover-based bento grid. Services: Massage Therapy, Hair Salon, Facials & Skin Care, Waxing, Body Treatment. When hovering a service, the corresponding luxury image reveals or parallax scales.

sections_blueprint.name: Enquiry & Booking (Prospect & Refuge)
sections_blueprint.features: A soft, rounded card 'Refuge' sitting on a wider atmospheric background 'Prospect'. Uses Shadcn forms deeply customized (e.g., variant with only bottom borders, no heavy outlines) to collect leads. Fields: Name, Email, Service Interest, Date, Message.

sections_blueprint.name: Footer
sections_blueprint.features: Massive typography 'VITAL BODY' spanning the width. Contact details elegantly laid out: (805) 643-6888, jaweal@yahoo.com, 309 Borchard Dr. Ventura. Open hours displayed cleanly.

components_to_use: Shadcn UI: Form, Input, Select, Button, Accordion (highly customized to fit luxury theme)
general_ui_ux_guidelines: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute for automated testing.
Do not center-align the main App container. Left alignment and intentional margins are key for luxury editorial flow.
No generic SaaS gradients. Use solid elegant colors or highly subtle grain textures.
Implement focus states that are accessible but maintain brand aesthetics (e.g., a thin offset ring in brand primary color).
instructions_to_main_agent: Set up Tailwind config with the specified colors, fonts (import via Google Fonts in index.css: Cormorant Garamond and Manrope), and extended spacing/typography utilities.
Ensure the hero animation absolutely nails the 'masked line-by-line reveal'. Wrap lines in overflow-hidden divs and animate the inner text.
For the Shadcn components (like Form/Input), strip out the default Vercel/SaaS look. Remove heavy rings and backgrounds; use minimal underlines or very subtle soft-rounded inputs.
Pay extremely close attention to the Spacing Scale. If you think it's enough space, add more. The design must feel expansive and serene.
Never use generic placeholder text or placeholder image URLs. Use the provided actual copy and the curated Unsplash/Pexels URLs in the media section.
Construct the layout natively in React without forcing everything into Shadcn Cards.
